:::{#def-icc}
#### Intraclass correlation

Under @def-one-way-re,
the **intraclass correlation** is the correlation
between two observations $j \neq k$ in the same group:

$$
\rho \eqdef \frac{\Cov{Y_{ij}, Y_{ik}}}{\sqrt{\Var{Y_{ij}}\Var{Y_{ik}}}}
$$ {#eq-icc}
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#cor-icc}
#### Intraclass correlation in terms of variance components

Under @def-one-way-re,

$$
\rho = \frac{\sigma_\alpha^2}{\sigma_\alpha^2 + \sigma^2}.
$$ {#eq-icc-vc}
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

::: proof

This proof uses @thm-re-cov.

$$
\ba
\rho
&\eqdef \frac{\Cov{Y_{ij}, Y_{ik}}}{\sqrt{\Var{Y_{ij}}\Var{Y_{ik}}}}
&& \text{(definition of intraclass correlation)}
\\
&= \frac{\sigma_\alpha^2}{\sqrt{\Var{Y_{ij}}\Var{Y_{ik}}}}
&& \text{(covariance from the moments theorem)}
\\
&= \frac{\sigma_\alpha^2}{\sqrt{(\sigma_\alpha^2 + \sigma^2)(\sigma_\alpha^2 + \sigma^2)}}
&& \text{(variances from the moments theorem)}
\\
&= \frac{\sigma_\alpha^2}{\sigma_\alpha^2 + \sigma^2}
&& \text{(square root of a square)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-icc-vc-proof}
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#exm-dyestuff-icc}
#### Intraclass correlation for the dyestuff batches

With the variance components from @exm-dyestuff-cov,
@cor-icc gives

$$
\ba
\rho
&= \frac{1764}{1764 + 2451}
&& \text{(substitute the variance components)}
\\
&= \frac{1764}{4215}
&& \text{(add)}
\\
&\approx 0.4185
&& \text{(divide)}
\\
&\approx 0.42
&& \text{(round to two decimal places)}
\ea
$$ {#eq-dyestuff-icc}

so about 42% of the variation in yield is between batches.
:::

The intraclass correlation is also the fraction of the total variance
$\Var{Y_{ij}} = \sigma_\alpha^2 + \sigma^2$
that comes from the random effect.
